title: Constraint: 3-D Array All Unique
constraints: All 27 elements of the 3 × 3 × 3 array must be distinct (values 0 … 63).
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: The LRM says `unique {cube};` works on any array, but **Verilator ignores it on multi-dimensional arrays** (the Compile stage will warn you). Test your code on the tools you have!
Portable alternative: compare every pair of elements once, using the flattened index `a*9 + b*3 + c` to order them.
`foreach (cube[a, b, c])` iterates over all three dimensions at once.
